candidates.comment: Thanks for the detailed profiling. This matches the shutdown tool-reference recomputation and policy-driven configuration cloning tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/349450. This report adds Fedora/Wayland, `chat.mcp.access=registry`, and a reproduction with 63 registered tools; those details are useful for checking the shared fix.

Thanks for the report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/331517 already tracks identifying which automation a History run belongs to when its session title differs. Your case of similar automations on different branches, and the suggestion to include the automation name in a hover, add useful context to that work.

Thanks for the detailed reproduction. This is the migration consequence of https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/349809, which already tracks the ignored hook-disablement setting and explicitly notes that it blocks guard migration. Please retain this acceptance case there: after explicitly pausing repository hooks, migration must be able to ask for confirmation and update local-guard.json together with its script while preserving the guard's behavior.

Thanks for the detailed logs. This matches the Fedora 45 signature-verification failure tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/338194, including confirmation on VS Code 1.146.0. Your report adds failures across Python, C/C++, and GitLens, plus successful Python and C/C++ installations when verification was bypassed; these details belong in the shared investigation.

Thanks for the report. The same Albatross (Preview) error is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/349607. This report additionally confirms that even "hello" fails on Windows 10 with VS Code 1.104.2 and Copilot Chat 0.31.5.

Thanks for the detailed investigation. The same Windows Extension Host startup failure with numeric environment-variable names is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/327815. Your report adds a concrete reproduction on VS Code 1.147.0 with `1=C:\Program Files\VMware\VMware Workstation`, plus confirmation that removing it from the process environment restores extension loading.

Thanks for the report. This shortcut collision is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/258281. Your report adds Windows 1.146.0 confirmation that repeated Ctrl+N presses discard pending edits and can advance into other modified files.

Thanks for explaining your iPad workflow. Native iPadOS support is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/255717, including the limitations of local file access and cloud alternatives. Your need for offline project management and live preview without Codespaces usage limits belongs in that discussion; the request remains open in the backlog.

Thanks for the detailed deployment context. This is covered by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/345237, which requests serving the dedicated Agents interface through code serve-web or a separate command. Your restricted-network and LAN/VPN scenarios add useful requirements: locally served frontend assets, direct Agent Host connectivity without cloud relays, and connection-token protection.

Thanks for the request. Remote Copilot BYOK support is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/332085, including SSH and other remote scenarios. Consolidating this report there also preserves the tunnel scenario and your request for an easier, explained switch to the Local harness; current switching guidance is at https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/332085#issuecomment-6002604036.

Thanks for the detailed report and tool comparison. Both failures are tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/348324. This adds reproduction on 1.148.0-insider with Qwen3.8-27B: insert, edit, and delete all fail, notebook creation fails too, and reading, execution, and package operations succeed. Please retain that comparison when consolidating the reports.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/326663, which tracks links expanding before click-drag selection finishes and proposes waiting until mouse-up. This report adds another recording showing how that prevents selecting link text to copy.

Thanks for the additional details. Integrated-terminal access in Copilot sessions is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/343575, where you also reported this limitation. Consolidating this report there, including your Windows 11 / VS Code 1.145.2 details and the “Error fetching embeddings: 403” encountered with tool discovery and your custom tool; that error's cause is not yet established.

Thanks for the report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/172536 already tracks the repeated letters and misplaced macOS accent picker in the integrated terminal. This adds a reproduction on macOS 14.8.9 with VS Code 1.146.0 over Remote - SSH; local-terminal behavior has not been tested.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/348434: the same session.auto_mode_resolved error at line 4 on Windows. This report also establishes that it occurs on VS Code 1.115.0 with Chat 0.43.0.

Thanks for the detailed report. The same checkpoint refs cluttering Git history, and the request to make them configurable, are tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/341659. Consolidating there should preserve your Windows 11 / VS Code 1.146.0 / Git Extensions details, the fact that `chat.checkpoints.enabled=false` does not stop ref creation, and your proposed opt-out or separate-storage alternatives.

Thanks for the report. The inability to stop agent terminals is already included in your earlier report at https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/348170. This adds a screenshot of the missing controls and the detail that you must use `pgrep` to find and terminate processes manually; those details belong with the same regression.

Thanks for the report. The same Ctrl+C and right-click copying failures in expanded chat terminal output are tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/291008. This report adds Linux Flatpak on VS Code 1.139.1, a long-running command, and a brief content flash when right-clicking.

Thanks for the detailed reproduction and analysis. This is the same workspace-root filtering bug tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/248992. Your macOS reproduction adds useful detail: the root disappears on expansion, returns after reload, and partially reappears when a file is opened.

Thanks for the detailed reproduction. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/322408 already tracks this same wrong-group write, including the collision when two endpoints expose the same model ID. This report adds a concrete customendpoint example: Provider A's existing shared-model setting captures changes intended for Provider B, while an initial write can succeed when neither group has an entry. That remaining case is not covered by the different-model-ID fix discussed here.

Thanks for the detailed report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/8078df0ea8d838f116f401a1ecb26042d68290d4 preserves the runtime's MCP result metadata through live completion and restored history, then includes it as `_meta` in the result delivered to the app. This addresses the mapping omission described here; it requires a Copilot runtime that supplies `mcpResultMeta`. The fix shipped in 1.145.0.

Thanks for the report. This is covered by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/337448, which tracks extension-provided Markdown syntax rendering in Preview but not in the new editor, including admonitions. Your Markdown Alert example is a concrete case of that compatibility gap.

Thanks for the detailed report. The selected-agent activation failure is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/343405. This report adds useful evidence: Dev Container through WSL2, a synced agent selected using a `vscode-remote://` URI while plugin materialization uses `file://`, Auto Intelligence, runtime 1.0.102, and successful behavior with the Local harness. The URI mismatch remains unconfirmed; the central issue is the selected agent not becoming active, rather than Auto model precedence.

Thanks for the report. The same locked `chat.sessionSync.enabled` setting without organization membership is tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/320335. This report adds screenshots and a Windows 11/WSL reproduction on Insiders 1.144.0.

Thanks for the detailed report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/331704 already requests disabling the Copilot Agent Host provider, including removing it from new-session selectors while keeping Chat and other providers available. Your reproduction with the Cloud/Claude/Codex settings disabled and diagnosis of the dynamically registered `agent-host-copilotcli` entry provide useful detail for that work; the background-agent setting does not cover this path.

Thanks for the report. This duplicates your earlier report at https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/342105, including the same URI error. Please retain the additional confirmation there that Authenticate also fails in a fresh Windows-only window without WSL or an open folder.

Thanks for the report and the detailed investigation. This is fixed by https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/bb40a4bb7b769f2a160835c2ef817736a6ff77da: the web Agents client now registers the service needed to construct the conversation widget, addressing the missing transcript and input. This fix does not establish that the separate tunnel-service or BYOK session-discovery inconsistencies are resolved. The fix shipped in 1.145.0.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/337280: Branch Changes reports changed files above chat but opens an empty editor in a remote workspace. This report adds a seven-file example on VS Code 1.141.1 with Windows/WSL Ubuntu-24.04 and the screenshot above.

Thanks for the report. This was addressed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/8fb60541db0e1a371ea40157e0f58951ae4a485d: Ctrl-selecting multiple Connected editor tabs now keeps a visible selection accent on both active and inactive selected tabs. The fix shipped in 1.145.0.

Thanks for the detailed report. This forwarding mismatch was fixed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/7878b2859cf8ccb0bb8e24122d19e8c82d7f4ed9: manual-only agents now carry disableModelInvocation: true into the Copilot runtime instead of relying on infer: false alone, preserving manual selection while restricting model-driven delegation. The fix shipped in 1.144.0.

Thanks for the report. This was fixed in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/f7c038950566f612cf4c11f57e52e4c2550bdf9e: right-clicking the Quick Open input now keeps the picker open while you use its context menu to paste. The fix shipped in 1.145.0.

Thanks for the detailed report. https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/313437 already contains this same custom-agent sample and all three comparison scenarios, including your clarification that default CLI sessions successfully use ask_user and sql while custom-agent sessions fall back to text. Keeping the investigation together there preserves that distinction and the screenshots.

Thanks for the report. This matches https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/302846, which tracks the empty Source Control panel when opening a repository file and the same regression from 1.109 to 1.110. This report adds Windows Server coverage, the Explorer double-click launch without a workspace, and the git.autoRepositoryDetection workaround; those details should remain part of the investigation.

Thanks for the report. The conversation disappearing when an empty window opens a workspace is already tracked in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/251644. This report adds the Windows 1.113.0 case: a planning conversation disappeared after opening a newly created folder, accompanied by a brief workspace-switch warning.

Thanks for the request. Windows 11 primary context-menu integration was enabled for stable builds in https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/commit/3e56b3a2a4002a63b82bdcfdb7ea5873dbc6957e, so “Open with Code” can appear directly on folders without Shift+right-click. This completes the requested capability; installation cases where the entry still does not appear are tracked separately, including https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/304214. The fix shipped in 1.109.0.
